events.description: Initialization of 3D Axes, Plane, and Cube Shell drawing
events.clip_query: A 3D coordinate system with a yellow wireframe cube drawing its edges at the origin.

events.description: Fading in coordinate labels and camera reorientation
events.clip_query: Text labels showing 3D coordinates appear next to the vertices of the cube as the camera rotates.

events.description: Highlighting base and top squares of the cube
events.clip_query: The top and bottom faces of the cube alternate in brightness to highlight its parallel structure.

events.description: Camera rotation to look down the corner and projecting the cube
events.clip_query: The camera aligns with the cube's main diagonal, and a flat 2D projection of the cube is cast onto a plane.
